name: Essay
definition: A short piece that states a claim, gives reasons with evidence, answers the other side and closes.

slots.says: gives its reasons after the claim
states the other side’s case fairly
closes by saying what the reader should now believe or do

name: Argument
definition: A piece written to win the reader over: a claim, the reasons for it, and a call to act.

slots.says: gives the reasons for its claim
states the other side’s case fairly
shows what is won or lost
ends by asking the reader to act

name: Anecdote
definition: A short account of one thing that happened, told to make a point.

slots.says: sets the scene in a line or two

name: Story
definition: An account of events in the order they happened: a scene, a turn, and what it meant.

slots.says: turns on a moment of change
ends by saying what it meant

name: Letter
definition: A piece written to one reader: a greeting, the news, what the writer asks for, and a sign-off.

slots.says: asks for what the writer wants

name: Speech
definition: A piece written to be heard: it greets the listeners, argues a claim and ends on a call.

slots.says: gives the reasons for its claim
states the other side’s case fairly
shows what is won or lost
ends with thanks or a farewell

name: Review
definition: A judgement of a book, a film or other work, with the reasons for it.

slots.says: gives the reasons for its judgement
points to moments in the work
ends by telling the reader whether to seek the work out
